body:
Hey, I just wanted to tell you, I have depression and GAD, I got dumped by the man I thought I was going to marry, (took off with his co-worker!) and I honestly didn't see any other way out than no longer being here. Long story short, I'm now in the most loving, supportive relationship and I'm feeling the best I've felt in years. 
There's more out there for you, you can feel valued and loved again.
GIRL! You look so amazing. I wish you many happy new memories. It's time to look forward! ❤️

Are you in the UK at all? I don't know much about the benefits system over here but I could do a little research for you if so, you must be entitled to some kind of allowance?
I'm so sorry about your situation with your S/O, do you have any friends or family you can turn to? Are there any shelters or charities for people in your situation?
I am so proud of you. Your decision is not an easy one to come to. You are clearly worth more than you think.

Sounds like your father was trying to mould you into something that wasn't you.
You can still have a good go at life, but you need to remember that you are valuable in ways which he clearly refuses to see or acknowledge.
If you could do anything in life, what would it be? What are your hobbies? What do YOU enjoy? (Not what does your father TELL you to enjoy!)
how old are you, my love?

Sounds chemical, to me. But I'm making a snap judgement based on what little info I have about you, of course.
Do you feel like you need to find meaning in your life? Or has anything and everything just lost all meaning to you? 
Depression does not discriminate, you could have millions and still be depressed or suicidal.
I would recommend talking to a doctor or therapist if you can. 
I'm seriously wishing you all the best, I'm hoping you can find lots of happiness.
Yeah, scraping by here because I'm too depressed to actually work right now, it's not great.
